name: usercase
description: Virtual users that browse your website in a real browser and tell you what they thought

api_key.title: Usercase API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to connect in the browser on first use. Or paste a key from Dashboard → Settings → Integrations → API keys (starts with eb_sk_)

diagnostics.title: Send diagnostics
diagnostics.description: When the tool can't do something on your site or misreads the screen, send the page path, the HTML around the element and a screenshot to the Usercase team (kept 30 days)
